sections.heading: File identification
body: Complete at contract acceptance. Keep on top of the file, physical or digital.

fields: Lender and loan officer where applicable:

sections.heading: Key dates at a glance
body: Copy from the Contingency Log. Update the day any date moves.

sections.heading: Document status at opening
body: Mark each expected document as attached, pending with need date, or not applicable.

sections.heading: Message header
body: Send before it is requested. State dates in every update.

sections.heading: Status body
body: Name the next three deadlines with dates and owners. Confirm receipt of anything load-bearing.

sections.heading: Notice
body: This template sends operational updates only. It does not give legal advice and does not interpret contract language. Verify state contract rules locally. Deadline questions on live files go to the broker or counsel the same day.

sections.heading: File facts
body: Complete within three business days of closing while details are fresh.

sections.heading: What slipped and what was learned
body: Name the deadline or document that caused the most stress, even if nothing was missed. Near misses teach as much as misses.

sections.heading: Follow-up done
body: Mark done only when the change exists, not when it is planned.
